# Claw3D retro-office attribution

This directory vendors selected helpers and the MIT license from
[iamlukethedev/Claw3D](https://github.com/iamlukethedev/Claw3D) (© 2026 Luke The Dev).

The Appli Taxi CRM **3D Office** runtime lives under
`components/sales-operation/office/` and `lib/sales-operation/office/`.
It is a CRM-bound React Three Fiber scene inspired by Claw3D’s retro-office
patterns (rooms, agents as spatial cues, immersive interaction).

**Not vendored / intentionally stripped:**
- OpenClaw Gateway WebSocket proxy
- Agents fleet / Studio settings
- Phaser office builder
- Immersive GitHub / phone / SMS agent workflows

See `LICENSE` in this folder for the MIT terms that apply to copied helpers.
